scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-config
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-config && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist node_modules
